workflows..github/workflows/build_site.yml:
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    tags: '*'
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: write
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: "pages"
  cancel-in-progress: true

name: Build and deploy GH Pages
jobs:
  build-site:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - name: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Write Changelogs
        run: |
          ./buildSite --repository ${{ github.repository }} --changelog

      - name: Build Zola
        run: |
          docker run --rm \
            -v "${{ github.workspace }}:/workspace" \
            -w /workspace \
            ghcr.io/getzola/zola:v0.22.1 build

      - name: Upload GitHub Pages artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@fc324d3547104276b827a68afc52ff2a11cc49c9 # v5.0.0
        with:
          path: public/

  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build-site
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v5

name: Morrobroom Manufacturing

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: main
    tags: ["*"]

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    uses: DreamWeave-MP/StroggForge/.github/workflows/rustGlobalBuild.yml@v42
    secrets: inherit
    with:
      # Required: JSON array of binary names to build. Add more for monorepos.
      binary_names: '["morrobroom"]'
      include_files: "README.md,LICENSE,THIRD_PARTY.md,resources,content"
      cargo_publish: false
      publish_docs: false
      enable_portmaster: false
      enable_android: false
